full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph looks steeply down over a city from a high outdoor platform, with one dark figure seen from behind in the foreground. The figure stands just below the center, wearing a rounded cap and a dark coat, facing the city below. A metal rail crosses the lower part of the picture in front of the body. To the right, a heavy dark structural edge rises diagonally, while several narrow cables run from the upper right toward the center and lower left. These near elements are almost black and sharply defined, framing the much paler city beyond. Tall rectangular buildings occupy the middle and far distance, but mist or smoke softens their edges. One narrow tower stands near the center; a larger, more detailed building with a stepped or open upper section sits to its left. Parallel streets and rooftops run diagonally between the towers, their patterns only partly visible through the pale atmosphere. The very top of the image fades almost to white, and the farthest structures dissolve into that brightness. No individual people or cars can be distinguished in the streets at this scale. The high viewpoint creates a strong downward pull, while the cables and railing emphasize the height and physical edge of the observation point. Fine grain, soft haze, and broad gray gradations dominate the distant city; the coat, rail, and nearby framework provide hard silhouettes. Daylight is diffused by the atmosphere, entering most strongly from above and behind the buildings, so the city is luminous but low in contrast. There are no readable signs or words. The overall composition sets one still observer against a vast, fading urban grid, balancing severe dark foreground geometry with a light-filled, almost weightless distance.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白照片：镜头从高处露天平台陡峭地俯瞰城市，前景有一个背对观众的深色人物。人物位于中央稍下方，戴圆帽、穿深色外套，面向下方城市。一道金属栏杆在身体前横过画面下部。右侧一块厚重深色结构斜向升起，几根细缆线从右上延向中央和左下。这些近处元素几乎全黑且边缘清楚，框住后方更浅的城市。高大的矩形建筑占据中景和远景，但薄雾或烟气柔化了边缘。一座窄塔立在中央附近，左边有一座上部呈阶梯或开放结构、细节更多的大楼。平行街道与屋顶在楼群间斜向延伸，其纹样只部分透过浅色大气显现。画面最上方几乎淡到白色，最远的结构也溶入其中。在这个尺度下，街道上无法区分单个人或汽车。高视点形成强烈向下的空间牵引，缆线与栏杆则强调观察点的高度和真实边缘。细颗粒、柔雾和宽阔灰阶渐层主导远处城市；外套、栏杆和近处框架提供硬朗剪影。日光被大气漫射，最强的亮度来自建筑后方与上方，因此城市明亮却反差较低。画中没有可读招牌或词语。整体构图把一个静止观察者置于广阔而逐渐淡去的城市网格前，以严峻的深色前景几何平衡充满光、近乎失重的远方。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome photography contrasts a hard near-black foreground structure with a pale distance dissolved by atmospheric haze. Strong diagonals and narrow crossing lines frame broad blocks and repeating fine grids below. The closest silhouettes retain crisp edges and substantial weight; farther forms lose contrast and definition in successive layers of gray. Diffuse daylight turns the upper distance luminous without distinct cast shadows, while film-like grain keeps even the palest spaces tactile. A steep viewpoint and converging lines give the frame powerful spatial depth. The overall effect is monumental and contemplative, with a small dark focal presence held against an expansive fading field.
style_prompt_zh: 单色摄影以坚硬的近黑色前景结构对照被大气雾霭溶解的浅色远方。强斜线和交错细线框住下方宽阔块面与重复的细网格。最近的剪影边缘清楚、分量沉实，较远形体在连续灰阶层次中逐渐失去反差和界定。漫射日光让上方远景发亮，却没有明确投影，胶片般颗粒使最浅的区域仍有可触质地。陡峭视点和汇聚线条带来强烈空间纵深。整体效果宏大而沉思，一个小小的深色视觉焦点置于广阔渐淡的色场前。
theme_en: A lone observer overlooking a hazy city from a high platform
theme_zh: 一人从高处平台俯看薄雾中的城市
name: Margaret Bourke-White
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
